newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $1.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle steady-up $1.00 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 per cwt lower, compared to last week's close, USDA said.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 67.00-75.50, including 43 head 696 lbs 67.00; 700-800 lbs 65.25-70.00; 800-900 lbs 59.50-65.00. Holsteins - Large 2 package 572 lbs 62.00; 700-800 lbs 54.50-60.75; 11 head 986 lbs 59.50.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 62.00-67.50. Cattle and Calves Receipts - 3,000
